raw_manifest_schema_proposal.basis: No machine-readable raw-artifact manifest schema exists in the repo; the prose convention (WO-INFRA3-R2-ACTIVATION-R1 section 2 item 3) requires path + sha256 + size + producer + retention with the manifest digest recorded in the ledger. This proposal formalizes it; adoption requires a new bounded WO with fresh Reviewer + distinct Verifier (per review/stop rules).

required_fields.artifact_path: path relative to the run raw root ~/nanolab/raw/<execution-id>/<attempt-id>/
required_fields.producer: command/binary + its digest (engine binary sha256 or script sha256) + host (hostname) + uid
required_fields.subject_head: Git HEAD (full SHA) of the nanolab checkout that produced the artifact
required_fields.subject_tree: Git tree SHA of that checkout
required_fields.storage_location: URI/class of durable storage (local raw root, archive target), plus copies if any
required_fields.retention: retention class + minimum retention period + deletion authority (owner-only)
required_fields.created_at_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of artifact creation
required_fields.scientific_outcome: always NOT_EVALUATED at dispatch/production time; analysis is a separate surface

invariants: One manifest per attempt; manifest digest recorded in the append-only ledger entry for that attempt
No raw artifact may be reused or referenced in analysis without its manifest digest + provenance
Manifest itself is append-only evidence; corrections are new manifests referencing the old manifest_id
Scientific interpretation NEVER attaches to raw artifacts at production time (scientific_outcome=NOT_EVALUATED)
